method: Execute an unchanged copy of up.sh with a fake docker executable and synthetic .env in a temporary directory. Expand the real Compose file via read-only docker compose config, then apply captured explicit service selection, dependency closure and scale overrides. No Docker daemon query, container creation or real .env read.
counting: Sum configured long-running container instances; one Go business executable per Go service instance. Excludes exited initialization jobs, init helpers, middleware child processes and browser processes.
